headline: AJOFM Bistriţa – Năsăud: 3.30% - Unemployment Rate at End of June 2026
summary: The county employment agency reported 3,674 unemployed people in Bistrita-Nasaud at end-June 2026, a rate of 3.30%, down 0.01 percentage points from May.
why: Regional labour market data in Romania offers a local read on employment conditions that feed into national labour and consumption trends.
